name: Eugene Vindman
bio: a Representative from Virginia; born in Kyiv, Ukraine, June 6, 1975; graduated from Franklin Delano Roosevelt High School, New York, N.Y.; B.A., Binghamton University, Binghamton, N.Y., 1997; M.A., Central Michigan University, Mt. Pleasant, Mich., 2005; J.D., University of Georgia, Atlanta, Ga., 2009; United States Army; staff, National Security Council; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
